accounting: Count all candidate and fixed-foe nodes, completed and incomplete. TreeStrap updates on complete candidate receipts only. TDLeafEpisode observes complete candidate receipts and finishes with censored None; no terminal W/L is supplied or recorded. No W/L, learned weights, fitness, or candidate ranking is output.
candidate_initialization: same random.Random(seed) vector per paired learner, [1.0]+four Uniform(0.5,1.5) coefficients; cost-only, no endpoint comparison.
execution_scope: The failed attempt created only a top-level started receipt then stopped before the first search. This corrected attempt gets its own start/result files, uses the same inputs and 900s cap, and is not an extension of any training cap. No W/L evaluation or outcome/weight output.
opening_seed_formula: 70000 + seed; sorted legal UCI actions then uniform choice; paired identical root by seed.
search_source: task2492.learning.AlphaBeta with task2492.adapters.ChessEnv; identical full-width D2/q0 search, randomized legal action order.
